title: KINGDOM HEARTS HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX
summary: Cutscenes run with sound and a solid green picture: the luma and chroma planes never reach the game's own textures. The same DLL also swallows the shutdown fault that makes Wine open a crash dialog when a launcher or a title closes, so one install fixes both.

excerpts.note: The game asks for decode into D3D video textures; the reader gets a copy of its attributes without the two that ask for it, so it decodes in software.
The decoded NV12 frame is written straight into the luma and chroma textures the game created, so its own shader has planes to convert.

cause: The same as Dream Drop Distance: the game copies the two planes of a shared NV12 texture into its own textures, which D3DMetal cannot hand it, so the picture is solid green.
